items.title: Saudi Arabia’s Wealth Fund Has 80% of Its U.S. Stock Portfolio in SpaceX
items.summary: A single disappearing holding just reshaped one of the world's biggest sovereign portfolios, and the stock that now dominates it is sliding. The next filing could reveal whether Saudi Arabia is doubling down or quietly backing away.

items.title: Waymo Ordered Off California Freeways for an “Imminent Hazard to Public Safety.” Tesla Has More at Stake
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCalifornia’s DMV ordered Alphabet’s Waymo off the state’s freeways, calling its driverless freeway operations “an imminent hazard to public safety. ”Tesla has far more at stake: it trades at about 178x forward earnings, compared with about 20x for Alphabet.
